A session-scoped Stop hook is now active with condition: "Raise our practice mean (best score per hosted case, GET /v1/me) on https://arena.tacto.ai/live from 0.727 toward 0.82+ AND make the agent robust for Sunday's Live Final (hidden cases, new suppliers). We are Team Codacabana. Work on branch steffen/price-engine (PR #12); read docs/learnings.md (Takeaways, Where we stand, claim table, Hypotheses) and docs/design.md (Implemented) first.

Budget: 35 practice runs left (100 total, 65 used); sandbox D01/D02 is free, use it for every mechanism test. OpenAI (gpt-6-luna, LLM_EFFORT=low) within $200, about $2 spent. Stop when 10 consecutive practice runs bring no meaningful improvement (>0.01 on the mean), or at 0.85.

Current best per case (ours / best of all teams): P01 0.974/0.995, P02 0.507/0.847, P03 0.923/0.936, P04 0.860/0.874 (capped near 0.87), P05 0.828/0.824, P07 0.751/0.779, P08 0.549/0.732, P10 0.679/0.702, P11 0.710/0.807, P18 0.485/0.677. The upside is in P02, P08, P18, P11.

Established facts (do not re-test):
- Suppliers agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they would make; stay below their counter until their final offer. Pushing past a final offer ends the case (walk-away).
- Verified claims "taken into account" lower where they stop, most in round 1. Irrelevant: their own older quotes outside the case refs, other suppliers' order prices, indices outside their cost drivers, currency rates.
- Wording moves price (D01: asking "what would you need" 50.00 to 49.40), but repeating a question every round backfires.
- Patience is about a 40% cumulative gap (sum per round of (their counter - our sheet)/their counter). Near-cost and pricing-committee suppliers end earlier; Nordmark (P02) walked at 19%.
- Only the standing sheet can be accepted (alternatives return 422): mirror a better alternative back.
- Raw-material distributors (P08, P18) refuse a fixed price beyond 12 months and any deadband: take their clause.
- RFQ: the arena serializes calls per session; the runner sends one message at a time by 60 s deadline.
- Round-1 counters: some suppliers follow our anchor (Werdenfels: anchor 4.77 gave 5.50, 5.68 gave 5.70); D01 did not (44 to 47 all gave 51.30).

Open hypotheses to test, cheapest first:
1. Lower round-1 counters for P02/P08/P18 through persona-specific arguments and wording in the first e-mail (hedge letter, open-book offer, partnership).
2. Round 1 with 2 to 3 sheets of equal C for us (payment vs ppm vs lead time) to reveal what each lever is worth (P10, P11).
3. Per-thread fit of the concession curve and patience instead of the fixed FRACTION/ANCHOR constants.
4. A deep anchor plus small, steady gaps afterwards, so leverage distributors run more rounds before their final offer.

Rules (AGENTS.md): no logic keyed on case or supplier IDs (generalise to unseen suppliers); never call /v1/events, /screen, /leaderboard, /results; no prompt injection; code owns every number, the model only writes words; every model call has a hard timeout; no em-dashes. Before each PR update run uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check . Record every finding in docs/learnings.md (date, tag, evidence session ID) and design changes in docs/design.md, in the same PR. Commit logs with git add -f logs/sessions logs/runs logs/practice-v*.log, and push to the PR after each batch. Never push to main. Keep the Live Final path (buyer run --set final, runner.play_waves) working; dry-run it on the sandbox before Sunday 09:00.

Log progress in docs/learnings.md after every batch: version, cases, scores, what changed.". Briefly acknowledge the goal, then immediately start (or continue) working toward it — treat the condition itself as your directive and do not pause to ask the user what to do. The hook will block stopping until the condition holds. It auto-clears once the condition is met — do not tell the user to run `/goal clear` after success; that's only for clearing a goal early.
Goal acknowledged: raise the practice mean from 0.727 toward 0.82+ with 35 practice runs, test mechanisms on sandbox first, and keep the final path robust. Starting with the docs.

1	# Agent design
2	
3	The target architecture of our buyer, merged from the team's planning notes (PRs #7 to #10,
4	10 Oct). What we learned in play is in `learnings.md`; this file says what we build.
5	
6	**Status.** The branch `steffen/price-engine` plays a code-only policy with a model-written
7	paragraph (`buyer/policy.py`, run by `buyer/runner.py`): practice mean of best scores 0.73 (from
8	0.32), sandbox D01 0.99, D02 0.73. What it does is under "Implemented" below; the rest of this file
9	is the target design. Julian's draft two (`origin/julian/draft-two`) holds a richer stance and
10	reader design that is not merged. The architecture diagram is on page 1 of
11	[how-it-works.pdf](how-it-works.pdf).
12	
13	## Implemented (price engine)
14	
15	| Module | Job |
16	|---|---|
17	| `buyer/economics.py` | C of a sheet; what a sheet is worth to the supplier (`supplier_value` plus overtime for a faster delivery than it quoted); term planning: every allowed combination priced at the supplier's own valuation, lowest C, ties to the supplier's side; the relationship-optimal price |
18	| `buyer/claims.py` | claim bank: should-cost below its price, our order prices, falling cost-driver indices, notice period, forecast, scorecard, case rival quotes, hedge and open-book notes; rival offers in an RFQ |
19	| `buyer/personas.py` | owner type, persona signals from notes, letters, quote remarks and news, cost of money |
20	| `buyer/policy.py` | per thread: anchor by goal and persona, 30 % of the gap per round, held low after a deep first concession, patience budget for near-cost, fully booked and relationship-goal suppliers; adopts its counter terms when they cost us less, mirrors a better alternative, takes a required index clause; claims 3 in round 1, then 1 per round; close on final offer, agreement or round limit |
21	| `buyer/writer.py`, `buyer/llm.py` | the e-mail: a model paragraph that answers the supplier's last e-mail (no digits, IDs or leaks, else the template), then claims and the proposal from code |
22	| `buyer/runner.py` | one message at a time per session, to the thread whose 60 s clock has run longest; keepalive questions for finished bidders; rollback when a send times out; accept the cheapest standing sheet; Live Final waves |
23	
24	## Principle
25	
26	Code owns every number and every binding decision; the model reads replies and writes e-mails.
27	Score is total cost C, not price. Every step has a fallback that still sends a move within 60 s.
28	
29	## A case
30	
31	1. **Prepare** (before the first move, about 20 s): open the session, build a case brief: C_open,
32	   C_alt, target, walk-away, the lever table (C of each allowed option), a view of each supplier,
33	   and a claim bank of verified arguments. A stance call proposes per-supplier parameters; code
34	   clamps them.
35	2. **Negotiate**, one thread negotiator per supplier, in parallel. Each round:
36	
37	   ```
38	   supplier reply
39	     -> READ    (model, hard timeout)  offer, intent, objections, statements
40	     -> CHECK   (code)  supplier statements against the data
41	     -> PLAN    (code)  candidate sheets scored with total_cost, filtered by must_haves_ok
42	     -> DECIDE  (code)  counter / accept / walk away, move size, claims
43	     -> WRITE   (model, hard timeout; template if late)  figures and IDs injected by code
44	     -> GUARD   (code)  every negotiable field, claim format, no leaks, no unplanned figures
45	   ```
46	
47	3. **Close**: accept the best sheet that keeps every must-have and beats C_alt, or walk away;
48	   at the latest 90 s before the wave's 8-minute cap.
49	4. **Learn**: store the trace and what we learned per supplier for the next practice run.
50	
51	## Modules
52	
53	| Module | Job | Run by |
54	|---|---|---|
55	| Runner | polls the final's case list, one coordinator per case, restarts after a crash | code |
56	| Coordinator | case brief, starts thread negotiators, shared state, decides when to close | code |
57	| Economics | C of any sheet, floor, anchor, target, concession steps, accept gate | code |
58	| Personas | one profile per supplier: traits with evidence, levers, history | model offline, code live |
59	| Claim bank | arguments as sentences with figure and data ID, computed as the arena checks them | code |
60	| Reader / writer | supplier e-mail to JSON; move to e-mail | small model, hard timeout |
61	| Fact check | supplier statements: confirmed, contradicted, selective, unverifiable (not built) | code |
62	| Guard | blocks leaks, unknown IDs, unplanned figures, broken must-haves | code |
63	| Fallback cascade | unknown supplier or part: case facts, data search, category averages, its documents | code |
64	
65	## What feeds the brief, by impact
66	
67	| # | Data | Decides | Where |
68	|---|---|---|---|
69	| 1 | case file, quote PDF | C directly: need, horizon, rates, must-haves, alternative, options, standard terms | `GET /v1/cases`, `arena_kit.docs.standard_terms` |
70	| 2 | supplier cost floor | anchor, target, relationship charge | `should_cost`, cost-breakdown XLSX on request |
71	| 3 | index values of its cost drivers | justified price change, strongest claims | `cost_drivers`, `index_values`, `facts.json` |
72	| 4 | letters, notes, news | what moves it (cash, capacity, relationship), notice periods | `documents`, `correspondence/`, `news` |
73	| 5 | negotiation history | how far it usually moves | `negotiation_history` |
74	| 6 | intel, our invoices | archetype, payment lever | `supplier_intel`, `invoices`, `suppliers` (cash discount) |
75	| 7 | contracts and clauses | notice, index clauses, expiry, single sourcing | `contracts`, `contract_clauses`, `sourcing` |
76	| 8 | scorecards, QNs | quality lever | `scorecards`, `quality_notifications` |
77	| 9 | forecasts, PO prices, rival quotes | volume, price history, rival arguments | `forecast_lines`, `po_lines`, `quotes` |
78	
79	The Sunday release (`data/release-sunday/`) and the case's own `facts` are read at runtime.
80	
81	## Supplier estimate
82	
83	`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` prices a deal for the supplier from `standard`, `interest_rate`,
84	`ppm` and `extra`; `relationship_cost` needs `full_cost` and is 0 without it. So we estimate:
85	
86	- **Full cost**: cost-breakdown XLSX, else `should_cost` moved by its drivers' index change, else
87	  quote minus an assumed margin. A relationship charge in a practice result reveals the true margin.
88	- **Cost of money**: cash discounts, cash-need notes, credit index, equity ratio. Seen rates: 0 to
89	  17 %/yr (`learnings.md`).
90	- **Extra**: overtime for speed (negative) or idle capacity filled by volume (positive), only from
91	  evidence. Volume, contract length and index clauses are not cash in `supplier_value`.
92	
93	C_best estimate: the cheapest allowed sheet whose supplier value stays above its floor, or C_alt.
94	
95	## Policy
96	
97	A stance per supplier (opening gap, capture, margin, justified share, steps) proposed by the model
98	at case open, clamped by code to a range per tier and goal, logged with a reason. Fallback
99	constants when the stance call times out:
100	
101	| Constant | Values |
102	|---|---|
103	| capture (share of possible saving before accepting) | leverage 0.75, quality_first 0.65, stabilise 0.6, secure_supply 0.55, routine 0.5 |
104	| opening gap below the quote (never below the floor) | strategic 5 %, important 8 %, standard 12 % |
105	| margin above full cost for the floor | case's `sustainable_margin_pct` in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, else strategic 4 %, important 2 %, standard 0 % |
106	| justified share offered in round 1 of a price increase | strategic 0.5, important 0.25, standard 0 |
107	| concession steps, only after the supplier moved | 35, 25, 15, 10 % of the remaining gap |
108	
109	Live signals adjust within bounds: approval needed shrinks steps (x0.7), high walk risk stops
110	price pushes. At the target, hold one more round while the supplier still moves.
111	
112	## Build order
113	
114	1. Accept and walk-away guard with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`.
115	2. Term search: every combination of allowed options, scored with standard terms for unstated
116	   fields. Fixes coverage and index-clause losses.
117	3. Supplier estimate: full cost and cost of money, giving target and walk-away.
118	4. Claim bank from `facts.json` and the index tables.
119	5. Persona reading and pacing.
120	6. Tune on practice traces, one change per batch.
121	
122	## Generalise
123	
124	- Branch on features (goal, must-haves, credit, cash signals, owner type, quote content), never on
125	  case or supplier IDs. No constants copied from one case.
126	- Hold out two or three practice cases for checking only.
127	- Test failure paths: late model call, malformed reply, a supplier that refuses everything,
128	  missing quote fields, a quote PDF without a standard-terms section.
129	- Change the agent only for a lesson seen in two cases or clearly general. Freeze early.
130	
131	## Tactics
132	
133	Use: data-backed anchors, requests framed as trades, two or three packages to watch the choice,
134	shrinking concessions with an ask in return, real rival offers cited by ID, a recap of every field
135	before closing.
136	
137	Avoid: invented figures or rival offers (`contradicted`), bluffed urgency or walk-aways (no
138	effect, `learnings.md`), squeezing a weak supplier in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, leaking
139	urgency, budget, target or a missing alternative. Prompt injection of supplier bots counts as an
140	attack on the arena: never.
141

1	"""The negotiation policy, per supplier thread: plan the non-price terms by C at the supplier's
2	own valuation, open below its quote, then move toward its counter round by round so it keeps
3	conceding, with verified claims spread over the rounds. Close on its final offer, its agreement or
4	the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.
5	
6	What the suppliers showed (sandbox and practice, `docs/learnings.md`):
7	- they concede only after a move from us and agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they
8	  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
9	- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
10	- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
11	  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
12	  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;
13	- a large first concession means a deep floor: then we hold low instead of meeting it."""
14	
15	import logging
16	import threading
17	import time
18	
19	from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
20	from arena_kit.play import latest, moves_left, standing
21	
22	from . import economics as eco
23	from . import llm, writer
24	from .claims import ClaimBank, rival_offer
25	from .personas import profile
26	
27	log = logging.getLogger("buyer")
28	
29	FRACTION = 0.3  # share of the gap to the supplier's counter we move per round
30	# Opening price as a share of its quote at our terms, by category goal. Practice C_best sat 12 to
31	# 22 % below the quote in leverage, routine and secure-supply cases, 1.5 to 3 % in stabilise ones.
32	ANCHOR = {"leverage": 0.78, "routine": 0.82, "secure_supply": 0.88, "quality_first": 0.88, "stabilise": 0.92}
33	ANCHOR_MIN = 0.75  # never open lower than this share (an insult costs patience)
34	BUDGET = 1.0  # patience: the cumulative relative gap we show (no cap for a typical supplier)
35	DEEP = 0.06  # a first concession this large (share of its quote) means a deep floor
36	MIN_MOVE = 0.002  # every sheet moves at least this share of the price
37	FIRST_CLAIMS, LATER_CLAIMS = 3, 1
38	DONE = {"agreed", "final_offer"}
39	ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}
40	QUESTION = "Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?"
41	
42	
43	class Side:
44	    """One supplier thread: what we know and what we did."""
45	
46	    def __init__(self, sid):
47	        self.sid = sid
48	        self.std = {}
49	        self.prof = {}
50	        self.est = {}
51	        self.terms = {}  # our planned non-price terms (with a price placeholder)
52	        self.quote = None  # its opening price at our terms
53	        self.anchor = None
54	        self.target = None  # relationship goals: the price with the lowest C
55	        self.budget = BUDGET
56	        self.claims = []
57	        self.ours = []  # our prices at s.terms, one per message with a sheet
58	        self.theirs = []  # its price at our terms, one per reply
59	        self.gaps = []  # relative gap of each of our sheets to its counter
60	        self.state = "open"  # open | mirror | closing | done | ended
61	        self.prev_state = "open"  # the state before the message in flight
62	        self.pending = None  # the message in flight: what to undo if it times out
63	        self.tried = set()  # (field, value) we switched away from
64	        self.term_change = False  # its last counter changed our non-price terms
65	        self.last_reply = None
66	
67	
68	class Negotiator:
69	    def __init__(self, case, pkg=None, complete=None):
70	        self.case, self.pkg, self.complete = case, pkg, complete
71	        self.bank = ClaimBank(pkg, case)
72	        self.sides = {}
73	        self.used = set()  # claim IDs cited in this case (a rival quote: per supplier)
74	        self.lock = threading.Lock()
75	        self.notes = []  # what we decided, for the log
76	
77	    # -- setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
78	    def setup(self, sid, events):
79	        case, s = self.case, Side(sid)
80	        s.std = standard_terms(events) or {}
81	        sheet_id, quote = standing(events)
82	        s.prof = profile(self.pkg, sid)
83	        self.sides[sid] = s
84	        if not sheet_id or quote.get("unit_price") is None:
85	            s.state = "ended"
86	            return s
87	        part = (case.get("parts") or [None])[0]
88	        full_cost, own_plant = self.full_cost(part, sid)
89	        lead = quote.get("lead_time_days") or s.std.get("lead_time_days")
90	        overtime = 0.005 if "capacity_full" in s.prof["signals"] else 0.001
91	        s.est = eco.estimate(case, s.std or quote, s.prof["rate"], full_cost, self.real_ppm(sid), lead, overtime)
92	        q_price = quote["unit_price"]
93	        goal, signals = case["buyer"].get("category_goal"), s.prof["signals"]
94	        ratio = ANCHOR.get(goal, 0.85)
95	        near_cost = bool(own_plant and full_cost >= 0.98 * q_price)  # it sells at our cost estimate
96	        if goal in eco.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
97	            s.budget = 0.3
98	        if "price_frozen" in signals:
99	            ratio = max(ratio, 0.95)  # its list price does not move far; a deep cut only costs patience
100	        if "capacity_full" in signals:
101	            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.93), min(s.budget, 0.16)
102	        if near_cost:
103	            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.97), min(s.budget, 0.14)
104	        current = case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price")
105	        if case.get("type") == "price_increase" and current:
106	            ratio = min(ratio, current / q_price)  # a price increase opens at today's price at most
107	        ratio = max(ANCHOR_MIN, ratio)
108	        # terms planned at the price we open with: coverage pays off at a low price, not at the quote
109	        planned = eco.plan_terms(case, s.std, s.est, quote, q_price * ratio)
110	        s.terms = planned[0] if planned else eco.at_price(case, quote, q_price * ratio)
111	        s.anchor = s.terms["unit_price"]
112	        s.quote = round(eco.price_for_value(case, s.terms, s.est, eco.value(case, quote, s.est)), 2)
113	        if full_cost and not near_cost:
114	            s.target = eco.relationship_optimum(case, s.terms, s.std, s.est, full_cost * 0.85, s.quote)
115	        s.claims = self.bank.for_supplier(sid, q_price)
116	        self.note(
117	            sid,
118	            "setup",
119	            quote=quote,
120	            std=s.std,
121	            profile=s.prof,
122	            full_cost=full_cost,
123	            near_cost=near_cost,
124	            terms=s.terms,
125	            quote_at_terms=s.quote,
126	            anchor=s.anchor,
127	            target=s.target,
128	            budget=s.budget,
129	            claims=[c["text"] for c in s.claims],
130	        )
131	        return s
132	
133	    def full_cost(self, part, sid):
134	        """(should-cost of the part, whether it models this supplier's own plant): full cost
135	        without margin. A generic estimate (a German cost base) says little about one supplier."""
136	        rows = self.bank.query("SELECT id, supplier_id, unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))
137	        own = [r for r in rows if r.get("supplier_id") == sid]
138	        if own:
139	            return own[0]["unit_cost"], True
140	        generic = [r for r in rows if not r.get("supplier_id")]
141	        if generic:
142	            return generic[0]["unit_cost"], False
143	        for ref in self.bank.ids("cost:"):  # the case's own facts (no table rows)
144	            f = self.bank.fact(ref)
145	            if f and f.get("part") == part and f.get("unit_cost"):
146	                return f["unit_cost"], f.get("supplier") == sid
147	        return None, False
148	
149	    def real_ppm(self, sid):
150	        """The defect rate it really delivers (latest scorecard), what a chargeback costs it."""
151	        ids = self.bank.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
152	        f = self.bank.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
153	        return f.get("ppm") if f else None
154	
155	    # -- reading its reply -------------------------------------------------------------------
156	    def their_price(self, s, terms):
157	        """Its sheet as a price at our planned terms (same value to it)."""
158	        same = all(terms.get(k) == v for k, v in s.terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in terms)
159	        if same:
160	            return terms["unit_price"]
161	        v = eco.value(self.case, terms, s.est)
162	        return round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, s.terms, s.est, v), 2)
163	
164	    def switch(self, s, new, why):
165	        """Plan new non-price terms; our last price moves to the same value for the supplier."""
166	        if s.ours:
167	            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1]), s.est)
168	            s.ours[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
169	        if s.theirs:
170	            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.theirs[-1]), s.est)
171	            s.theirs[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
172	        s.terms = {**new}
173	        self.note(s.sid, "switch_terms", why=why, terms={k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != "unit_price"})
174	
175	    def adopt(self, s, sheets):
176	        """Its reply changed some of our non-price terms (in its counter or an alternative): it told
177	        us what it values. Take a sheet's terms over when C at its price beats C of our plan at
178	        our counterpart of that price; when it insists on an index clause, take the clause that
179	        costs us least."""
180	        if not s.ours:
181	            return
182	        case = self.case
183	        standing_terms = sheets[0]["terms"]
184	        clause = standing_terms.get("index_clause")
185	        if "index_clause" in s.terms and s.terms["index_clause"] != clause and clause:
186	            # it will not sell this term at a fixed price (raw-material distributors), and it
187	            # refuses a deadband: we take its clause and keep negotiating the price
188	            self.switch(s, {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}, "its index clause")
189	        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
190	        for sheet in sheets:
191	            terms = sheet["terms"]
192	            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}
193	            changed.pop("index_clause", None)
194	            if not changed:
195	                continue
196	            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
197	            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
198	                continue
199	            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):
200	                continue  # we were there before: no flip-flop
201	            c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, new, terms["unit_price"]), s.std, s.est)
202	            if c < best_c - max(1.0, 0.001 * best_c):
203	                best_c = c
204	                s.tried |= {(k, repr(s.terms.get(k))) for k in changed}
205	                self.switch(s, new, f"its sheet {changed} costs us less")
206	
207	    # -- one move ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
208	    def move(self, sid, threads):
209	        """The next message to this supplier: {"message": ...}, or None when the thread is done."""
210	        case, s, events = self.case, self.sides[sid], threads[sid]
211	        s.prev_state = s.state
212	        last = latest(events)
213	        status = last.get("status")
214	        if s.state == "ended" or status in ENDED:
215	            s.state = "ended"
216	            return None
217	        sheets = [sh for sh in last.get("term_sheets") or [] if sh.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
218	        if not sheets:
219	            s.state = "ended" if not standing(events)[0] else "done"
220	            return None
221	        s.std = standard_terms(events) or s.std
222	        fresh = s.last_reply is not last
223	        if fresh:
224	            terms_before = dict(s.terms)
225	            self.adopt(s, sheets)
226	            s.term_change = any(sheets[0]["terms"].get(k, v) != v for k, v in terms_before.items() if k != "unit_price")
227	            s.theirs.append(self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"]))
228	            s.last_reply = last
229	        theirs = s.theirs[-1]
230	        if s.state in ("mirror", "closing"):  # we sent its own sheet or our target: done
231	            s.state = "done"
232	            return None
233	        if status in DONE or moves_left(case, events) <= 0:
234	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, moves_left(case, events))
235	        if s.target and theirs <= s.target * 1.002:
236	            # relationship goal: below the target a lower price costs more than it saves
237	            s.state = "closing"
238	            return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, max(s.target, theirs))], [], events, theirs)
239	        if s.ours and theirs <= s.ours[-1]:  # it came below what we offered: take it
240	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, moves_left(case, events))
241	        price, n_claims, question = self.next_price(s, theirs)
242	        claims = self.pick(s, n_claims, threads)
243	        return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, price)], claims, events, theirs, question)
244	
245	    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
246	        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
247	        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
248	        if not s.ours:
249	            return s.anchor, FIRST_CLAIMS, QUESTION
250	        last = s.ours[-1]
251	        gap = (theirs - last) / theirs
252	        conceded = (s.theirs[-2] - theirs) / s.theirs[-2] if len(s.theirs) > 1 else 0.0
253	        share = FRACTION
254	        if len(s.ours) == 1 and conceded >= DEEP and not s.term_change:
255	            # a deep floor: a pure price drop this large means it moves fast on its own (job shops,
256	            # P05, D02); a drop that came with terms it added (an index clause, P08, P18) is not one
257	            share = 0.08
258	        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
259	        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
260	        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
261	            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
262	        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
263	        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
264	        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
265	        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS, None
266	
267	    def finish(self, s, sheets, events, theirs, left):
268	        """Its final word, its agreement or our last message: if one of its alternatives costs us
269	        less than its standing sheet, send that sheet back so it agrees to it; else done."""
270	        case = self.case
271	        std = s.std
272	        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
273	        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]
274	        alts = [(c, sh) for c, sh in alts if eco.must_haves_ok(case, sh["terms"], std)]
275	        if alts and left > 0:
276	            c, sh = min(alts, key=lambda r: r[0])
277	            if c < c_stand - 1.0:
278	                s.state = "mirror"
279	                terms = {k: v for k, v in sh["terms"].items() if k in case["negotiable"]}
280	                return self.send(s, [eco.complete_offer(case, terms)], [], events, theirs)
281	        s.state = "done"
282	        return None
283	
284	    def pick(self, s, n, threads):
285	        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
286	        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
287	        out = []
288	        rivals = []
289	        for other, events in threads.items():
290	            if other == s.sid or latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
291	                continue
292	            oid, t = standing(events)
293	            if oid and t.get("unit_price") and s.theirs:
294	                price = self.their_price(s, t)
295	                if price < s.theirs[-1]:
296	                    rivals.append((price, rival_offer(other, oid, t["unit_price"])))
297	        pool = [c for _, c in sorted(rivals, key=lambda r: r[0])[:1]] + s.claims
298	        for c in pool:
299	            key = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for i in c["ids"]]
300	            if any(k in self.used for k in key):
301	                continue
302	            out.append(c)
303	            if len(out) >= n:
304	                break
305	        return out
306	
307	    def facts(self, s, sheets, claims, moved):
308	        """Plain statements the model may use, true by construction."""
309	        case, out = self.case, []
310	        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
311	        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
312	            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
313	        if "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"]:
314	            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")
315	        if "contract_months" in case["negotiable"]:
316	            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")
317	        if any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in claims) or any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in s.claims):
318	            out.append("our demand forecast for this part is rising")
319	        if s.ours and len(s.ours) > 1 and s.ours[-1] > s.ours[-2]:
320	            out.append("our proposal moves toward them again")
321	        if moved:
322	            out.append("they moved in their last reply and we appreciate it")
323	        if claims:
324	            out.append("the e-mail cites data right after this paragraph (do not repeat it)")
325	        out.append("the proposal with all terms follows after the data (do not repeat it)")
326	        return out
327	
328	    def send(self, s, sheets, claims, events, theirs, question=None):
329	        first = not s.ours
330	        moved = len(s.theirs) > 1 and s.theirs[-1] < s.theirs[-2] - 0.005
331	        price = sheets[0]["unit_price"]
332	        keys = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]]
333	        s.pending = {"state": s.prev_state, "keys": keys}
334	        if s.state not in ("mirror",):
335	            s.ours.append(price)
336	            s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
337	            s.pending["appended"] = True
338	        tone = "warm" if s.prof.get("warm", True) else "friendly and businesslike"
339	        asked = len(s.ours) in (1, 3)
340	        para = llm.paragraph(
341	            self.complete,
342	            writer.brief(
343	                self.case, s.prof, latest(events).get("body"), self.facts(s, sheets, claims, moved), tone, asked
344	            ),
345	        )
346	        body = writer.email(
347	            self.case, sheets, claims, question, first=first, moved=moved, warm=s.prof.get("warm", True), paragraph=para
348	        )
349	        refs = sorted({i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]})
350	        self.note(s.sid, "send", state=s.state, theirs=theirs, ours=price, claims=[c["kind"] for c in claims])
351	        subject = latest(events).get("subject") or f"Re: {self.case['title']}"
352	        if not subject.lower().startswith("re:"):
353	            subject = f"Re: {subject}"
354	        return {
355	            "message": {
356	                "subject": subject[:300],
357	                "body": body,
358	                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
359	                "refs": refs,
360	            }
361	        }
362	
363	    def commit(self, sid):
364	        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
365	        s = self.sides[sid]
366	        if s.pending:
367	            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])
368	            s.pending = None
369	
370	    def rollback(self, sid):
371	        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
372	        s = self.sides[sid]
373	        if s.pending:
374	            if s.pending.get("appended"):
375	                s.ours.pop()
376	                s.gaps.pop()
377	            s.state = s.pending["state"]
378	            s.pending = None
379	            self.note(sid, "rollback")
380	
381	    # -- close -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
382	    def fallback_close(self, threads):
383	        """(supplier, message) after a failed close: accept the cheapest standing sheet that keeps
384	        the must-haves, else walk away."""
385	        best = None
386	        for sid, events in threads.items():
387	            oid, terms = standing(events)
388	            std = standard_terms(events) or self.sides[sid].std
389	            if oid and latest(events).get("status") not in ENDED and eco.must_haves_ok(self.case, terms, std):
390	                c = eco.cost(self.case, terms, std)
391	                if best is None or c < best[0]:
392	                    best = (c, sid, oid)
393	        if best is None:
394	            return next(iter(threads)), {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}
395	        return best[1], {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}
396	
397	    def best_offer(self, threads):
398	        """(C, supplier, term_sheet_id) of the cheapest acceptable standing sheet (only a standing
399	        sheet can be accepted; alternatives were sent back to become standing)."""
400	        best = None
401	        for sid, events in threads.items():
402	            if latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
403	                continue
404	            oid, terms = standing(events)
405	            side = self.sides.get(sid) or Side(sid)
406	            std = standard_terms(events) or side.std
407	            if oid and eco.acceptable(self.case, terms, std):
408	                c = eco.cost(self.case, terms, std, side.est)
409	                if best is None or c < best[0]:
410	                    best = (c, sid, oid)
411	        return best
412	
413	    def close(self, threads):
414	        best = self.best_offer(threads)
415	        if best is None:
416	            live = [sid for sid, ev in threads.items() if latest(ev).get("status") not in ENDED] or list(threads)
417	            self.note(None, "walk_away")
418	            return {"supplier_id": live[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
419	        self.note(best[1], "accept", c=best[0], offer=best[2])
420	        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}
421	
422	    def note(self, sid, what, **kw):
423	        entry = {"t": round(time.time(), 1), "supplier": sid, "what": what, **kw}
424	        self.notes.append(entry)
425	        log.info(
426	            "%s %s %s",
427	            self.case["case_id"],
428	            sid,
429	            {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k not in ("claims", "std", "profile")},
430	        )

435	    return {"subject": subject[:300], "body": writer.keepalive(), "term_sheets": []}

438	def deadline_near(deadline, margin=90):
439	    cap = deadline() if callable(deadline) else deadline
440	    return bool(cap) and time.time() > cap - margin

1	"""Plays cases with the policy. The arena answers one call per session at a time and each thread's
2	60-second clock runs from the supplier's reply, so one loop sends one message at a time, always to
3	the thread whose clock has run longest; finished threads get a short question before their clock
4	runs out while the others still negotiate; then the cheapest acceptable sheet is accepted.
5	`play_waves` is the kit's Live Final loop with this runner."""
6	
7	import functools
8	import json
9	import logging
10	import threading
11	import time
12	from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
13	from pathlib import Path
14	
15	from arena_kit.client import ArenaError
16	from arena_kit.play import ENDED, RemoteTable, fetch_documents, latest, moves_left, quota_used_up
17	
18	from .policy import Negotiator, deadline_near, keepalive_message
19	
20	log = logging.getLogger("buyer")
21	RUNS = Path("logs/runs")
22	KEEPALIVE_AFTER_S = 35  # a finished thread gets a question this long after the supplier's reply
23

25	def play_case(table, case_id, pkg=None, deadline=None, complete=None):
26	    case, threads = table.open(case_id)
27	    if getattr(table, "done", None):  # resumed a case that had already ended
28	        return table.done
29	    for events in threads.values():
30	        for m in events:
31	            fetch_documents(table, m)
32	    neg = Negotiator(case, pkg, complete)
33	    for sid, events in threads.items():
34	        neg.setup(sid, events)
35	    replied = {sid: time.monotonic() for sid in threads}
36	    # round 1 goes out cheapest quote first: if a clock runs out, it is the least promising one's
37	    order = sorted(threads, key=lambda sid: neg.sides[sid].quote or float("inf"))
38	    rank = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(order)}
39	    result = None
40	
41	    def open_threads():
42	        return [s for s in threads if neg.sides[s].state not in ("done", "ended") and live(s)]
43	
44	    def live(sid):
45	        return latest(threads[sid]).get("status") not in ENDED
46	
47	    while not deadline_near(deadline):
48	        todo = sorted(open_threads(), key=lambda s: (replied[s], rank[s]))
49	        waiting = [
50	            s
51	            for s in threads
52	            if neg.sides[s].state == "done"
53	            and live(s)
54	            and todo
55	            and time.monotonic() - replied[s] > KEEPALIVE_AFTER_S
56	            and moves_left(case, threads[s]) > 0
57	        ]
58	        if not todo:
59	            break
60	        if waiting:  # a finished bidder whose clock runs out first: keep it alive
61	            sid = min(waiting, key=lambda s: replied[s])
62	            message = keepalive_message(threads[sid])
63	        else:
64	            sid = todo[0]
65	            move = neg.move(sid, threads)
66	            if move is None:
67	                continue
68	            message = move["message"]
69	        try:
70	            reply = table.send(sid, message)
71	        except ArenaError as e:
72	            if e.status != 409:
73	                raise
74	            log.info("%s %s: %s", case_id, sid, e.detail)
75	            neg.rollback(sid)  # it never got this message: our last offer stands for it
76	            reply = table.missed(sid, e)
77	            if "result" in reply:
78	                result = reply["result"]
79	                break
80	            threads[sid].append(reply)
81	            replied[sid] = time.monotonic()
82	            continue
83	        neg.commit(sid)
84	        threads[sid] += [{**message, "from": "buyer"}, reply]
85	        replied[sid] = time.monotonic()
86	    if result is None:
87	        for events in threads.values():  # the latest quote PDFs: standard terms for the close
88	            for m in events[-2:]:
89	                try:
90	                    fetch_documents(table, m)
91	                except ArenaError as e:
92	                    log.warning("%s: document not fetched: %s", case_id, e)
93	        decision = neg.close(threads)
94	        try:
95	            result = table.close(decision["supplier_id"], decision["message"])
96	        except ArenaError as e:
97	            log.warning("%s: close failed (%s), accepting a standing sheet", case_id, e)
98	            result = table.close(*neg.fallback_close(threads))
99	    save(table.session_id, case_id, neg, result)
100	    return result
101

103	def save(session_id, case_id, neg, result):
104	    RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
105	    keep = ("deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "score")
106	    path = RUNS / f"{case_id.split(':')[-1]}_{session_id}.json"
107	    out = {"case": case_id, "session": session_id, "notes": neg.notes, "result": {k: result.get(k) for k in keep}}
108	    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=str))

111	def play_all(client, case_ids, pkg=None, parallel=8, complete=None):
112	    """Practice or sandbox: many cases at once. {case_id: result or the exception that stopped it}."""
113	    used_up = threading.Event()
114	
115	    def one(case_id):
116	        if used_up.is_set():
117	            return case_id, ArenaError(429, "not started: the practice quota is used up")
118	        try:
119	            return case_id, play_case(RemoteTable(client), case_id, pkg, complete=complete)
120	        except ArenaError as e:
121	            if quota_used_up(e):
122	                used_up.set()
123	            log.warning("%s: %s", case_id, e)
124	            return case_id, e
125	        except Exception as e:  # one broken case must not stop the others
126	            log.exception("%s failed", case_id)
127	            return case_id, e
128	
129	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=parallel) as pool:
130	        return dict(pool.map(one, case_ids))
131	
132	
133	def play_waves(client, pkg=None, waves=5, parallel=10, poll=5.0, complete=None):
134	    """The Live Final: wait for each wave, play its cases in parallel within the wave's cap."""
135	    started, closed, caps = {}, set(), {}
136	
137	    def one(case, deadline):
138	        try:
139	            return play_case(RemoteTable(client, case), case["case_id"], pkg, deadline, complete)
140	        except Exception as e:  # one broken case must not stop the others
141	            log.exception("%s failed", case["case_id"])
142	            return e
143	
144	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=parallel) as pool:
145	        while len(closed) < waves or not all(f.done() for f in started.values()):
146	            try:
147	                cases = client.cases("final")
148	            except ArenaError as e:
149	                if e.status != 403:  # 403: no wave has started yet
150	                    raise
151	                cases = []
152	            for case in cases:
153	                if not case.get("open"):
154	                    closed.add(case["wave"])
155	                    continue
156	                if case.get("seconds_left") is not None:
157	                    caps[case["wave"]] = time.time() + case["seconds_left"]
158	                if case["case_id"] not in started and case.get("seconds_left"):
159	                    log.warning("wave %s: %s", case["wave"], case["case_id"])
160	                    started[case["case_id"]] = pool.submit(one, case, functools.partial(caps.get, case["wave"]))
161	            time.sleep(poll)
162	    return {case_id: f.result() for case_id, f in started.items()}

2	its notes, letters, quote remarks and news, and from those its cost of money. Unknown suppliers
3	(not in the package, e.g. the sandbox) get the neutral profile."""

5	import re
6	from pathlib import Path
7	
8	SIGNALS = {
9	    "cash_need": r"pay earlier|bank is watching|cash and the banks|within 10 days|under pressure"
10	    r"|restructures|short-time work|lowers rating|cash is tight|we like fast payers",
11	    "spare_capacity": r"second shift has been on hold|take additional parts|looks for new customers|free capacity",
12	    "capacity_full": r"order intake is very strong|binding 12-month commitment"
13	    r"|cannot confirm your full forecast|fully booked|allocates volumes|factory is super busy",
14	    "open_book": r"walk us through their calculation",
15	    "stale_costing": r"not followed his material|own spreadsheet",
16	    "partnership_2022": r"kept supplying at the old price",
17	    "reference_customer": r"important reference customer",
18	    "approval_2pct": r"above 2 % need the approval",
19	    "deprioritising_us": r"reviewing small accounts|not strategic|reorganising our range"
20	    r"|supply from stock only|sharpens its focus",
21	    "price_frozen": r"no room on price|not discounted|price list applies to all|discounts not possible"
22	    r"|frozen all price reductions",
23	    "hedged": r"bought their \w+ forward|covered at fixed prices|material covered until|secures power prices",
24	    "complains_late_pay": r"invoices are overdue",
25	}
26	# Cost of money per year by owner type (seen in practice: groups 4 to 7 %, family firms 7 to 8.5 %,
27	# founder-run job shops 12 to 17 %); a cash need adds to it.
28	RATE = {"group": 0.05, "private": 0.07, "family": 0.075, "founder": 0.12}
29	DEFAULT_RATE = 0.07
30	
31	
32	def signals_in(text):
33	    return sorted(k for k, pat in SIGNALS.items() if re.search(pat, text or "", re.I))
34	
35	
36	def profile(pkg, sid):
37	    """{owner_type, country, category, signals, rate, warm}; neutral when the package does not know it."""
38	    out = {"owner_type": None, "country": None, "category": None, "signals": [], "rate": DEFAULT_RATE, "warm": True}
39	    if pkg is None or not pkg.lookup(sid):
40	        return out
41	    try:
42	        sup = pkg.query("SELECT country, category, skonto_days, skonto_pct FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?", (sid,))
43	        intel = pkg.query("SELECT owner_type, staff FROM supplier_intel WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
44	        docs = pkg.query("SELECT file FROM documents WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
45	        remarks = pkg.query("SELECT remarks FROM quotes WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
46	        news = pkg.query("SELECT headline, body FROM news WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
47	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite: neutral
48	        return out
49	    texts = [r.get("remarks") or "" for r in remarks] + [f"{n['headline']}. {n['body']}" for n in news]
50	    for d in docs:
51	        path = Path(pkg.root) / (d.get("file") or "")
52	        if d.get("file") and path.is_file():
53	            texts.append(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
54	    sig = signals_in("\n".join(texts))
55	    owner = intel[0]["owner_type"] if intel else None
56	    rate = RATE.get(owner, DEFAULT_RATE)
57	    if "cash_need" in sig:
58	        rate += 0.05
59	    if sup and sup[0].get("skonto_pct") and sup[0].get("skonto_days"):
60	        # a cash discount of s % for paying d days early is worth s / d * 360 % a year to it
61	        days_early = max(1, 30 - int(sup[0]["skonto_days"]))
62	        rate = max(rate, min(0.2, sup[0]["skonto_pct"] / 100 * 360 / max(days_early, 10) / 2))
63	    out.update(
64	        owner_type=owner,
65	        country=sup[0]["country"] if sup else None,
66	        category=sup[0]["category"] if sup else None,
67	        signals=sig,
68	        rate=round(rate, 3),
69	        warm=owner in (None, "family", "founder", "private"),
70	    )
71	    return out

38	def months_back(month, n):
39	    y, m = (int(x) for x in month.split("-"))
40	    m -= n
41	    while m <= 0:
42	        m, y = m + 12, y - 1
43	    return f"{y}-{m:02d}"

46	def money(x):

50	class ClaimBank:
51	    """Arguments for one case. `pkg` is the data package (or None); the case's own `facts` win."""
52	
53	    def __init__(self, pkg, case):
54	        self.pkg, self.case = pkg, case
55	        self.facts = case.get("facts") or {}
56	        self.refs = list(case.get("refs") or [])
57	        # a case whose refs the package does not know (the sandbox's demo world)
58	        self.foreign = bool(self.refs) and pkg is not None and not any(pkg.lookup(r) for r in self.refs)
59	
60	    def fact(self, ref):
61	        if ref in self.facts:
62	            return self.facts[ref]
63	        return None if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else self.pkg.lookup(ref)
64	
65	    def ids(self, prefix):
66	        out = set() if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else set(self.pkg.ids(prefix))
67	        out |= {k for k in self.facts if k.startswith(prefix)}
68	        out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}
69	        return sorted(out)
70	
71	    def query(self, sql, params=()):
72	        if self.foreign or self.pkg is None:
73	            return []
74	        try:
75	            return self.pkg.query(sql, params)
76	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a package without SQLite: facts only
77	            return []
78	
79	    # -- single arguments ------------------------------------------------------------------
80	    def should_cost(self, part, sid, quote):
81	        best = None
82	        for ref in self.ids("cost:"):
83	            f = self.fact(ref)
84	            if not f or f.get("part") != part or not f.get("unit_cost"):
85	                continue
86	            if ref.endswith("-" + sid.split(":")[-1]):
87	                best = (ref, f)
88	                break
89	            if best is None and "-" not in ref.split(":")[-1]:
90	                best = (ref, f)
91	        if not best:
92	            return None
93	        ref, f = best
94	        if quote and f["unit_cost"] >= quote * 0.98:
95	            return None  # above or near its price: argues its case
96	        return {
97	            "kind": "should_cost",
98	            "ids": [ref],
99	            "text": f"Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is {money(f['unit_cost'])} per unit ({ref}).",
100	            "strength": 5,
101	        }
102	
103	    def order_history(self, part, sid, quote):
104	        rows = self.query(
105	            "SELECT id FROM po_lines WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 3",
106	            (part, sid),
107	        )
108	        facts = [(r["id"], self.fact(r["id"])) for r in rows]
109	        facts = [(i, f) for i, f in facts if f and f.get("unit_price")]
110	        if len(facts) < 2:
111	            return None
112	        prices = [f["unit_price"] for _, f in facts]
113	        if quote and min(prices) >= quote:
114	            return None
115	        ids = [i for i, _ in facts]
116	        if len(set(prices)) == 1:
117	            text = f"Our last {len(ids)} orders for this part were at {money(prices[0])} ({', '.join(ids)})."
118	        else:
119	            text = f"Our last orders for this part were at {' and '.join(money(p) for p in prices)} ({', '.join(ids)})."
120	        return {"kind": "order_history", "ids": ids, "text": text, "strength": 4}
121	
122	    def notice(self, sid):
123	        doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
124	        f = self.fact(doc) if doc else None
125	        if not f or f.get("days") is None:
126	            return None
127	        ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:") and "#" not in r), None)
128	        c = self.fact(ctr) if ctr else None
129	        if not c or c.get("days") is None or f["days"] >= c["days"]:
130	            return None
131	        text = (
132	            f"Your letter gives {f['days']} days' notice ({doc}); our agreement provides for {c['days']} days ({ctr})."
133	        )
134	        return {"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5}
135	
136	    def index_change(self, series):
137	        ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
138	        if not ids:
139	            return None
140	        m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
141	        m1 = months_back(m2, 12)
142	        a, b = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m1}"), self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m2}")
143	        if not a or not b or not a.get("value"):
144	            return None
145	        pct = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
146	        if pct > -0.5:
147	            return None  # a rising driver confirms the supplier's case
148	        name = SERIES_NAME.get(series, f"The index {series}")
149	        return {
150	            "kind": "index",
151	            "ids": [f"idx:{series}@{m1}", f"idx:{series}@{m2}"],
152	            "text": f"{name} changed {pct:.1f}% from {m1} to {m2} (idx:{series}@{m1}, idx:{series}@{m2}).",
153	            "strength": 3 + min(3.0, abs(pct) / 3),
154	        }
155	
156	    def drivers(self, part):
157	        return [r["series_id"] for r in self.query("SELECT series_id FROM cost_drivers WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))]
158	
159	    def forecast(self, part):
160	        ids = self.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@")
161	        f = self.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
162	        if not f or (f.get("change_pct") or 0) <= 0:
163	            return None
164	        text = f"Our forecast for this part is up {f['change_pct']:.1f}% ({ids[-1]})."
165	        return {"kind": "forecast", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
166	
167	    def rival_quote(self, part, sid, price):
168	        """A quote of this case from another supplier, cheaper than this supplier's price."""
169	        out = []
170	        for ref in self.refs:
171	            f = self.fact(ref) if ref.startswith("quote:") else None
172	            if f and f.get("part") == part and f.get("supplier") != sid and price and f["unit_price"] < price:
173	                out.append(
174	                    {
175	                        "kind": "rival",
176	                        "ids": [ref],
177	                        "text": f"We hold another quote for this part at {money(f['unit_price'])} per unit ({ref}).",
178	                        "strength": 6,
179	                        "rival": True,
180	                    }
181	                )
182	        return out
183	
184	    def signal_notes(self, sid):
185	        """Its own words in our notes that weaken its case: material bought forward at fixed prices,
186	        an offer to open its calculation. Context for the person reading, not a checked figure."""
187	        out = []
188	        for d in self.query(
189	            "SELECT id, date, kind, file FROM documents WHERE supplier_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC", (sid,)
190	        ):
191	            path = self.pkg.root / (d.get("file") or "") if self.pkg else None
192	            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if path and path.is_file() else ""
193	            if re.search(r"covered at fixed prices|bought their \w+ forward|material covered until", text, re.I):
194	                out.append(
195	                    {
196	                        "kind": "hedged",
197	                        "ids": [d["id"]],
198	                        "text": f"Your letter of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) says your material is covered at fixed "
199	                        "prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.",
200	                        "strength": 5,
201	                    }
202	                )
203	            if re.search(r"walk us through their calculation", text, re.I):
204	                out.append(
205	                    {
206	                        "kind": "open_book",
207	                        "ids": [d["id"]],
208	                        "text": f"In our call of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) you offered to walk us through your "
209	                        "calculation; we would welcome that now.",
210	                        "strength": 4,
211	                    }
212	                )
213	        seen, uniq = set(), []
214	        for c in out:
215	            if c["kind"] not in seen:
216	                seen.add(c["kind"])
217	                uniq.append(c)
218	        return uniq
219	
220	    def currency(self, sid):
221	        """A supplier paying its costs in a currency that weakened against the euro earns more of it
222	        per euro: the ECB rate (its currency per euro) rose."""
223	        rows = self.query("SELECT country FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?", (sid,))
224	        cur = COUNTRY_CURRENCY.get(rows[0]["country"]) if rows else None  # it invoices in EUR, pays costs locally
225	        if not cur:
226	            return None
227	        ids = self.ids(f"idx:ECB-{cur}@")
228	        if not ids:
229	            return None
230	        m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
231	        m1 = months_back(m2, 12)
232	        a, b = self.fact(f"idx:ECB-{cur}@{m1}"), self.fact(f"idx:ECB-{cur}@{m2}")
233	        if not a or not b or not a.get("value"):
234	            return None
235	        pct = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
236	        if pct < 0.5:
237	            return None  # its currency got stronger: that argues its case
238	        refs = f"idx:ECB-{cur}@{m1}, idx:ECB-{cur}@{m2}"
239	        return {
240	            "kind": "currency",
241	            "ids": [f"idx:ECB-{cur}@{m1}", f"idx:ECB-{cur}@{m2}"],
242	            "text": f"The euro rose {pct:.1f}% against the {cur} from {m1} to {m2} ({refs}), so your costs "
243	            f"in {cur} take fewer euros.",
244	            "strength": 4 + min(3.0, pct / 3),
245	        }
246	
247	    def scorecard(self, sid, quality):
248	        ids = self.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
249	        if not ids:
250	            return None
251	        f = self.fact(ids[-1])
252	        if f is None:  # demo world: cite without a figure
253	            text = f"We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard ({ids[-1]})."
254	            return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
255	        if quality:
256	            if (f.get("ppm") or 0) < 1000:
257	                return None
258	            text = f"Your deliveries ran at {f['ppm']} ppm in {f['quarter']} ({ids[-1]})."
259	        else:
260	            if (f.get("otd_pct") or 100) >= 90:
261	                return None
262	            text = f"Your on-time delivery was {f['otd_pct']}% in {f['quarter']} ({ids[-1]})."
263	        return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
264	
265	    def demo_refs(self):
266	        """Refs the package cannot resolve: cited without a figure."""
267	        words = {
268	            "cost": ("should_cost", "Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file ({ids}).", 5),
269	            "po": ("order_history", "We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part ({ids}).", 4),
270	        }
271	        out = []
272	        for kind, (name, text, strength) in words.items():
273	            ids = [r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(f"{kind}:") and self.fact(r) is None]
274	            if ids:
275	                out.append(
276	                    {"kind": name, "ids": ids[:3], "text": text.format(ids=", ".join(ids[:3])), "strength": strength}
277	                )
278	        doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
279	        ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:")), None)
280	        if doc and ctr and self.fact(doc) is None and self.case.get("type") == "price_increase":
281	            text = f"Your letter ({doc}) gives less notice than our agreement provides for ({ctr})."
282	            out.append({"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5})
283	        return out
284	
285	    # -- per supplier ----------------------------------------------------------------------
286	    def for_supplier(self, sid, quote):
287	        """Every argument for this supplier that pushes our way, strongest first."""
288	        case, out = self.case, []
289	        quality = case.get("type") == "quality" or case["buyer"].get("category_goal") == "quality_first"
290	        single = len(case.get("parts") or []) == 1  # a bundle's price is not one part's order price
291	        for part in case.get("parts") or []:
292	            history = self.order_history(part, sid, quote) if single else None
293	            out += [c for c in (self.should_cost(part, sid, quote), history) if c]
294	            out += [c for c in (self.index_change(s) for s in self.drivers(part)) if c]
295	            out += self.rival_quote(part, sid, quote)
296	            if c := self.forecast(part):
297	                out.append(c)
298	        if c := self.notice(sid):
299	            out.append(c)
300	        out += self.signal_notes(sid)
301	        if c := self.currency(sid):
302	            out.append(c)
303	        if c := self.scorecard(sid, quality):
304	            out.append(c)
305	        if self.foreign:
306	            out += self.demo_refs()
307	        seen, uniq = set(), []
308	        for c in sorted(out, key=lambda c: -c["strength"]):
309	            if tuple(c["ids"]) not in seen:
310	                seen.add(tuple(c["ids"]))
311	                uniq.append(c)
312	        return uniq

1	"""The model writes one paragraph of each e-mail: it answers the supplier's last e-mail like a
2	person would (its questions, its points, its situation). Code writes everything that binds or is
3	checked: figures, data IDs, the proposal. A paragraph with any digit, data ID or leak is dropped
4	and the template stands in. Hard timeout: the move goes out without the model if it is late."""
5	
6	import logging
7	import os
8	import re
9	import time
10	
11	import httpx
12	
13	log = logging.getLogger("buyer")
14	TIMEOUT_S = 20.0
15	FORBIDDEN = re.compile(
16	    r"\d|\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):|urgent|urgency|deadline|budget|no alternative|"
17	    r"walk away|other options|last chance|desperate|must close|time pressure|target price",
18	    re.I,
19	)
20	
21	SYSTEM = """You are a senior buyer at Hollerau Pumpenwerke, a German pump maker, writing to a supplier.
22	Write ONLY the middle paragraph of our reply e-mail: 2 to 4 sentences, plain text, no greeting, no
23	sign-off, no lists.
24	
25	In it:
26	- answer the supplier's last e-mail like a thoughtful person: respond to what it asked and to the
27	  reasons it gave, using only the facts listed under WHAT WE CAN SAY;
28	- acknowledge its situation where the notes give one (for example cash needs, full capacity, rising
29	  costs, a long relationship), sincerely and briefly;
30	- if it asks for something we cannot give, say so kindly and point to what we do offer;
31	- ask one short question only if QUESTION ALLOWED is yes.
32	
33	Never write any number, price, percentage, date, quantity or data ID (code adds the figures). Never
34	mention urgency, deadlines, a budget, our alternatives or the lack of them, a target price, or that
35	we will walk away. Never invent facts, promises or commitments. Be polite, factual and warm unless the
36	tone says firm."""
37	
38	
39	def complete_from_env():
40	    """(system, user) -> text with the team's OpenAI-compatible model, or None when not configured."""
41	    model, key = os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL"), os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY")
42	    if not model or not key:
43	        return None
44	    base = os.environ.get("LLM_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1").rstrip("/")
45	    client = httpx.Client(timeout=TIMEOUT_S, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"})
46	
47	    effort = os.environ.get("LLM_EFFORT", "low")
48	
49	    def complete(system, user):
50	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
51	        body = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "reasoning_effort": effort}
52	        r = client.post(f"{base}/chat/completions", json=body)
53	        r.raise_for_status()
54	        return r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
55	
56	    return complete
57	
58	
59	def paragraph(complete, brief):
60	    """The model's paragraph for this brief, or None (no model, late, broken or unsafe)."""
61	    if complete is None:
62	        return None
63	    t0 = time.monotonic()
64	    try:
65	        text = (complete(SYSTEM, brief) or "").strip()
66	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - a slow or broken model must not cost the move
67	        log.warning("writer model failed after %.1fs: %s", time.monotonic() - t0, e)
68	        return None
69	    text = " ".join(text.split())
70	    if not text or len(text) > 900 or FORBIDDEN.search(text):
71	        log.warning("writer paragraph dropped: %r", text[:200])
72	        return None
73	    log.info("writer paragraph in %.1fs", time.monotonic() - t0)
74	    return text

5	import functools
6	import json
7	import logging
8	import os
9	import statistics

11	
12	from arena_kit import ArenaClient, ArenaError, RemoteTable, play, play_all
13	from arena_kit.cli import load_env, summary
14	from arena_kit.play import hosted, play_waves
15	
16	from . import llm, runner
17	from .agent import AGENTS, load_package, naive_factory
18	
19	LOGS = Path("logs/sessions")
20	
21	
22	def pull(client, set_):
23	    """Save every ended session of a set that has its trace to logs/sessions/<set>/, once."""
24	    out = LOGS / set_
25	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
26	    saved = 0
27	    for s in client.sessions(set_):
28	        path = out / f"{s['case_id'].split(':')[-1]}_{s['session_id']}.json"
29	        if s["status"] != "ended" or path.exists():
30	            continue
31	        state = client.session(s["session_id"])
32	        if not (state.get("result") or {}).get("trace"):  # final: the trace comes after the final
33	            continue
34	        try:
35	            state["backoffice"] = client.backoffice(s["session_id"])
36	        except ArenaError:
37	            state["backoffice"] = None
38	        path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
39	        saved += 1
40	    print(f"{saved} new sessions in {out}")
41	
42	
43	def main(argv=None):
44	    load_env()
45	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="buyer")
46	    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
47	    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
48	    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
49	    verbose.add_argument("--no-llm", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS, help="template e-mails only")
50	    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
51	    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
52	    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
53	    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
54	    p.add_argument("case_id")
55	    p.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
56	    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
57	    r = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every playable case of a set in parallel; final: wave by wave")
58	    r.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
59	    r.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
60	    r.add_argument("--data", **data)
61	    r.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
62	    r.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
63	    r.add_argument("--cases", help="practice or sandbox: only these cases, e.g. P01,P08")
64	    s = sub.add_parser("pull", help="save finished sessions with trace and back office to logs/sessions/")
65	    s.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
66	    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
67	    args.no_llm = getattr(args, "no_llm", False)
68	    logging.basicConfig(
69	        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
70	        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
71	        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
72	    )
73	    client = ArenaClient()
74	
75	    if args.cmd == "pull":
76	        return pull(client, args.set)
77	    naive = args.agent == "naive"
78	    pkg = None if naive else load_package(args.data)
79	    complete = None if naive or args.no_llm else llm.complete_from_env()
80	    if args.cmd == "play":
81	        table = RemoteTable(client)
82	        try:
83	            if naive:
84	                result = play(table, args.case_id, naive_factory()())
85	            else:
86	                result = runner.play_case(table, args.case_id, pkg, complete=complete)
87	        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
88	            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
89	        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
90	        state = client.session(table.session_id)
91	        print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{state.get('replay_url')}")
92	        pull(client, state["set"])
93	    elif args.set == "final":  # no human in the loop: waits for each wave, plays it within its cap
94	        parallel = min(args.parallel, 10)

96	            out = play_waves(client, naive_factory(), args.waves, parallel)
97	        else:
98	            out = runner.play_waves(client, pkg, args.waves, parallel, complete=complete)
99	        for case_id, result in out.items():

103	        if args.cases:

# Negotiation strategies: research for our buyer agent

Research report, 10 October 2026. Two inputs: (1) the literature on automated negotiation,
bargaining, procurement practice and LLM negotiators, gathered by ten parallel research agents;
(2) our own 62 logged practice sessions (`logs/sessions/`), read again to see which of those ideas
fit the arena's supplier bots. Each recommendation says what supports it and how to test it. Most
literature points were read from abstracts and summaries, not full papers: treat effect sizes as
directional (sources and confidence at the end).

## Summary

The current price engine scores a mean of **0.73** over the ten hosted cases (best run per case).
The gaps that remain are concentrated: P10 (0.68, 194k EUR from C_best), P08 (0.55, 79k), P18
(0.49, 37k), P11 (0.71, 28k), P07 (0.75, 23k), P02 (0.51, 23k).

What the traces show about the bots, in literature terms: a **behaviour-dependent conceder**
(Faratin, Sierra and Jennings' tactic family) that answers each of our steps with a smaller step
of its own, becomes a little more generous late, and ends the dance with `final_offer` once its
patience is used up. It ends the dance after 2 to 6 of our messages, so the 10-message limit
never binds. **The first counter decides most of the deal.**

Recommendations, ranked by expected gain against cost to build:

| # | Change | Why | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Make round 1 count:** three equal-C sheets (MESO), the strongest claims, a precise anchor with a reason | the first counter holds 40 to 100 % of our final price cut; MESOs anchor harder and reveal priorities | sandbox D01/D02, then P07, P08, P18 |
| 2 | **Answer the supplier's stated need every message**, also when the term is fixed | P11 Kalwisz asked for faster payment five times ("you haven't addressed this at all"), then stopped at 45.50 | P11 replay |
| 3 | **Concede in currencies, not price:** hold one or two terms it values back from round 1 and spend one per round as our move | concessions are only answered after a move; logrolling moves price without paying price | sandbox, then P07 / P08 |
| 4 | **Spend patience in fewer, larger steps** | the bot gives back only 0.2 to 0.7 of each step and stops on a cumulative gap; many small steps burn patience without buying price | sweep `FRACTION` 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 on the sandbox (free) |
| 5 | **Expected-value acceptance after `final_offer`** | pushing after `final_offer` walked once (D01); the gain from one more step is small | already behind `BUYER_PUSH_FINAL`; decide from data |

9	## Verdict
10	
11	The code runs on every case structure we know. Its tuning is in-sample and unmeasured beyond
12	the ten hosted cases. The biggest gaps for Sunday: new suppliers get a neutral profile because
13	the release's letters and news never reach the persona code; one exception loses a whole case
14	(or every later wave); four or more bidders time out.
15	
16	| # | Risk | Damage | Fix | Effort |
17	|---|---|---|---|---|
18	| 1 | an exception in a move or the wave poll | a case at its alternative (0 in 6 of 21), or all later waves | catch per move, keep polling | small |
19	| 2 | release rows invisible to SQL; most suppliers without text | neutral profile for new suppliers | read release rows via the ID index; scan the supplier's e-mails | small to medium |
20	| 3 | 4 or more bidders | timeouts, lost patience, ended threads | stop sending to the worst bidders after round 1 | medium, a tactics decision |
21	| 4 | missed phrasings in `SIGNALS` | traits not detected | widen to word stems | small |
22	| 5 | `price_unit` ignored | wrong-direction rival or order-price claims | divide by `price_unit` | small |
